patches.name: Unlock Android folders
patches.description: Makes Android/data, Android/obb and all other folders visible and selectable in the system file picker. Apply to com.android.externalstorage.

patches.name: Allow any folder
patches.description: Removes the folder restriction in the system folder picker (e.g. Android/media/com.whatsapp).
